title: Graduate Women International Fellowships for Women 2027
description: Apply for GWI international fellowships supporting postgraduate and doctoral research, training, and academic development. Open to women graduates and researchers worldwide.
descriptionDetailed: Graduate Women International awards fellowships and grants that help women pursue postgraduate study, doctoral research, and academic training. Recipients work on topics including women's health, education, social development, and gender equality, and join an international community of women scholars. The next call for applications is expected to open in October 2027.

entry.feeNote: Free for GWI members. Non-members pay a non-refundable administration fee of CHF 100 (industrialised countries) or CHF 50 (countries with low per-capita GNI).

prize.description: GWI fellowships are the equivalent of CHF 8,000 to 10,000, while grants range from CHF 3,000 to 6,000 and recognition awards are about CHF 1,000. Award amounts are indicative and vary each competition; between 16 and 25 fellowships and grants are offered per cycle.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to women graduates and researchers
audience.eligibilityDetail: Applicants should be women pursuing postgraduate study, doctoral research, or academic or professional training. Fellowships are offered for the second and subsequent years of a doctoral programme, so applicants must show proof of completing their first year by the closing date. Awards are used for research in a country other than where the applicant was educated or habitually resides.
